messages:
Omar Li: Hey all, first-day puzzle 9144bb389. My new MBP booted fine but System Settings shows "Device management: Pending" and there's a FileVault prompt asking for an escrowed recovery key. I didn't get an email. Device serial: C02XQ0ZQFH00.

Becca (IT): Welcome Omar! :wave: Can you confirm if you enrolled during setup or if autopopulated by Jamf? Also paste output of `profiles status -type enrollment`.

Omar Li: I signed in with SSO during OOBE. `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "Device is enrolled: Yes (MDM) - Jamf Pro - Last contact 2m ago". The FileVault prompt shows "Recovery key required to unlock the disk" and a Recovery Key ID.

Eli - Mac Admin: If jamf shows enrolled, the key should be escrowed to Jamf. I'll look up the serial. Jamf-bot, show FileVault escrow for C02XQ0ZQFH00.

jamf-bot: Jamf lookup: device(C02XQ0ZQFH00) -> FileVault escrow: NOT FOUND. Enrollment: yes. Last check-in: 2026-08-10T08:12:49Z.

Eli - Mac Admin: Hrm. Likely the device shipped from staging before the FV escrow policy ran. Omar, don't try entering random keys. Can you DM me the Recovery Key ID from the screen and confirm you have no personal data yet?

Omar Li: DM sent. No personal data, clean machine. I just want to install Rosetta and Homebrew to get started. I'm on M2 so Rosetta is optional but I need it for one Intel-only tool.

Becca (IT): Two options: 1) We can reimage (fast) and ensure escrow runs before shipping, or 2) if you're comfortable we can decrypt and re-encrypt after we get the key from staging. Since it's new and you have no data, reimage is simplest. Which do you prefer?

Omar Li: Reimage is fine. Faster to start coding.

Eli - Mac Admin: Ok starting reimage/autopilot wipe. Keep it plugged in. Jamf will push our provisioning profile which includes FileVault escrow and a temporary local admin for 2 hours so you can install devtools.

jamf-bot: Jamf policy 'autopilot-reimage-1787654321' triggered by Eli at 2026-08-10T08:20:03Z.

Omar Li: Device went through OOBE and I'm at the desktop. Company portal shows a pending OS update and a message "Completing device setup".

Eli - Mac Admin: Pushing FV escrow policy now and creating temp admin. After you confirm desktop, run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` then paste outputs.

Omar Li: `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "Enrolled via Jamf Pro". `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On." Looks like protector present.

jamf-bot: Jamf action 'temp-admin-2h' assigned to OMAR\\omar.li by Eli at 2026-08-10T08:34:11Z. Expires at 2026-08-10T10:34:11Z. FileVault escrow recorded.

Omar Li: Got temp admin, installed Rosetta with `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` and Homebrew. Ran `sudo jamf flush` and `sudo jamf enroll -verbose` for good measure. All green.

Becca (IT): Nice. We'll revoke admin at expiry. Welcome aboard Omar 389. If you hit the recovery dialog again DM Eli directly.

Omar Li: All set, thanks everyone! :grin:
